t0_risks_and_gaps: FY2023 cash additions to PPE exceed operating cash flow; net income cannot be substituted for distributable equity cash flow.
Adjusted FCF uses net capex and other adjustments; do not treat it as the same definition as NVDA or AMD FCF.
Intel is an integrated manufacturer with substantial foundry investment, unlike fabless peers.
No post-T0 restated segment history is imported.

The release discloses a January 2023 change in estimated production-equipment useful life from five to eight years; management estimates FY2023 depreciation fell by USD4,200 million and gross profit increased by USD2,500 million relative to the previous life estimate. Reported gross margin is affected by this accounting estimate, not solely economic improvement.
